title: Traditional Rice Kheer
steps: Wash and soak the basmati rice for 30 minutes. Drain and coarsely crush it with your hands.
In a heavy-bottomed pan, bring the milk to a boil.
Add the crushed rice, lower the heat, and simmer, stirring frequently to prevent sticking.
Cook for about 40 minutes until the milk reduces and thickens, and the rice is completely soft.
Stir in the sugar and cardamom powder. Cook for another 10 minutes.
Remove from heat, garnish with chopped nuts, and chill in the refrigerator before serving.
